A circle is inscribed in a square with side length 8. What is the area of the region inside the square but outside the circle? Express your answer in terms of $\pi$.

Solution:  
The square has side length $8$, so its area is  
\[
8^2 = 64.
\]  
The inscribed circle has diameter equal to the side length of the square, so its radius is  
\[
\frac{8}{2} = 4.
\]  
The area of the circle is  
\[
\pi(4^2) = 16\pi.
\]  
The area inside the square but outside the circle is the difference:  
\[
64 - 16\pi = \boxed{64 - 16\pi}.
